notes: Yarok, the Desecrated (CR 603.2d), the falsifier of yarok_doubles_an_entering_creatures_trigger. Printed: 'If a permanent entering causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.' Hanged Executioner enters under seat 1's control: its enters trigger is an ability of a permanent seat 1 controls, not of one Yarok's controller controls, so it triggers once: one Spirit.
